name: Rila Monastery
description: Rila Monastery sits in a deep forested valley of the Rila Mountains, about 117 km south of Sofia, Bulgaria, at roughly 1,150 metres. Founded in the 10th century around the hermit St John of Rila's retreat, it was rebuilt after a fire in the 1830s–1860s. Today about 60 monks live there, and pilgrims and visitors come to see its striking courtyard and living tradition.
